metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded using a 64-channel QuickCap (32 active electrodes) and a Neuroscan SynampsRT amplifier at 1000 Hz sampling rate, with impedance kept below 10 kΩ. tDCS was delivered via a Starstim 8 system (Neuroelectrics) targeting left or right dlPFC (anode F3/F4, returns at surrounding sites) at 2 mA for 20 minutes with ramp-up, or sham stimulation. Preprocessing was performed in MATLAB using EEGLAB and ERPLAB, including band-pass filtering (0.1–30 Hz), downsampling to 250 Hz, re-referencing to average mastoids, bad-channel detection, ICA-based artifact removal (ADJUST, SASICA), epoching (-200 to 5000 ms), baseline correction, and artifact rejection based on amplitude and FASTER metrics, followed by condition-wise ERP averaging.
